settings.scope: Instantaneous spectral-only simulation on sampled eligible ABI overlap population and grouped held-out Sunny columns. ABI 2-to-10 km box-footprint processing differences are included assuming transfer and independence from the other source errors. Scene-library original modified-log ADM. ABI SRFs define taxonomy; ECO goal SRFs define physical flux retrieval. Assignment transitions are measured on held-out ABI pixels with added NEdT and a fixed GMM, then propagated through Sunny scene ADMs and included under the explicit assumption of similar ECO response. Conditional scene-level transitions are independent of simulated ECO radiometric noise.

rows.combination: Independent spatial increment; signed biases added; not a paired ensemble
